description: Checks a full workout video render and returns the player link once it is ready. Use when the progress card from export_workout_video refreshes. Not for starting a render (use export_workout_video). Returns status, progress and, when done, a stream link for the player.

id.description: ID of the workout. Get it from list_team_workouts.

locale.description: Language of the voice-over and on-screen text, e.g. "en-US" or "de-DE". Omit for the team default.

name: get_workout_video
title: Get workout video status
